record.original_question: Generalize Wick rotation so as to determine under what conditions a Lorentzian metric can be changed into a Riemannian metric.

evidence.quote: Question 3.2. Generalize the Wick rotation to study under what conditions one can change Lorentzian metrics to Riemannian metrics.

artifact.status_search_result: Several partial generalizations of the Wick rotation have been proposed (rank-one deformations, complex analytic metrics, Vielbein formulations, Wick rotation in the lapse for foliated manifolds, and admissible complex metrics characterizing positivity of energy in QFT). Each has limited applicability, and no general intrinsic necessary-and-sufficient criterion for converting an arbitrary Lorentzian metric into a Riemannian one is known. The problem remains open in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Wick rotation in the lapse, admissible complex metrics, and foliation changing diffeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces a Wick rotation in the lapse interpolating between Riemannian and Lorentzian metrics on manifolds admitting a codimension-one foliation; provides admissibility conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress: a generalized Wick rotation is constructed under specific foliation hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: How to Wick rotate generic curved spacetime (Visser)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys multiple approaches—rank one deformations, complex analytic metrics, Vielbein formulations—each with different range of applicability and limitations.
status_evidence.claim: No single general criterion is known; multiple partial frameworks coexist.

status_evidence.title: Wick Rotation and the Positivity of Energy in Quantum Field Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Defines a domain of complex-valued metrics whose boundary contains real Lorentzian metrics, characterizing admissibility for QFT.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial sufficient conditions via complexification, not a full intrinsic criterion.
